transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I'm Maj. Rowan, Maintenance Control Officer. I need to begin the quarter-end property reconciliation for the items currently tagged as unserviceable — battery packs, rugged tablets, power converters, and electronic test cables. Per policy, I need to confirm current technical status and disposition recommendations with the responsible sections before I sign the disposition order. Could the property office, repair bench, and calibration desk each provide their current status and recommendations for these items so we can proceed?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. Regarding the six unserviceable battery packs: the battery shop confirmed this morning that all six have swollen casings covered by a manufacturer safety bulletin. They must be quarantined rather than repaired. We have property-office pickup scheduled for Wednesday at 1000. I should note that the inspection sheet is still in the shop binder and has not yet been entered in the maintenance control log — we'll get that entered so your records are complete before you sign the order.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I need to provide the current technical status and disposition recommendation for the rugged tablets. IT support completed certified data erasure on all eight rugged tablets and found them serviceable for the training cell. They must be reissued to the training cell with an asset transfer scheduled for Friday at 0900. I should note that the data erasure certificates are filed in the IT ticket system but have not been attached to the reconciliation packet — I'll make sure those are included before you sign the order.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I can provide the current technical status and disposition recommendation for the power converters. The power systems bench verified this morning that all four unserviceable power converters have replaceable fan modules and should be sent for repair, with repair-bench priority 2. I should note that the bench verification was completed this morning, but the work-order recommendation has not yet been posted — I'll make sure that gets posted so your records are complete before you sign the order.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Good morning, Major. I can provide the current technical status and disposition recommendation for the electronic test cables. The calibration desk confirmed that the ten electronic test cables failed their scheduled calibration check but remain suitable for controlled calibration return. They must be sent to the calibration desk with a calibration request dated Tuesday. I should note that the signed calibration worksheet is awaiting property-section filing — I'll make sure that gets filed so your records are complete before you sign the order.
transcript.speaker: A5
